newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi Sec mulls merging affiliated brokerages.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi Sec mulls merging affiliated brokerages.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd said on Wednesday that one option for helping its affiliated brokerages would be to merge them into one entity.
The securities house, which is one of Japan's top four brokerages, said that it would decide on measures to assist the struggling affiliates as soon as possible.
"The company is considering helping its affiliates from a number of viewpoints. A merger is one option," a spokesman for Yamaichi said.
The Yamaichi affiliates are Naigai Securities Co Ltd, Naito Securities Co Ltd, Daichu Shoken and Ogawa Shoken.
Naigai Securities is a medium-sized brokerage based in Tokyo and Naito Securities is a medium-sized brokerage based in Osaka.
Daichu and Ogawa are small brokerages based in Osaka.
